name: library
description: A lending desk for a small library: catalog, loans, fines, reports and JSON exports.
author: harness developer (dev split)

issues.description: Returning a book never removes the loan from the member's list, so the loan limit counts returned books and a member at the limit can never borrow again.
issues.fix_hint: Remove loan_id from the member's loans when the loan is closed.

issues.description: The docstring says a loan is overdue from the day after its due date, but the check already counts the due date itself.
Days late are counted from the day the book was borrowed instead of the due date, so a book returned on time is fined.
The default result list is created once and shared, so every search without an explicit list adds to the results of the earlier searches.
issues.fix_hint: Default to None and create a new list inside the function.

issues.description: The export name is joined to the folder unchecked, so a name like ../../x reads or writes files outside the export folder.
issues.fix_hint: Resolve the path and refuse names that leave the export folder.

issues.description: loans imports reports for the receipt and reports imports loans (inside a function) for LOAN_DAYS, so the two modules depend on each other.
Four nested conditions inside the loop where guard clauses (continue) would read flat.

issues.anchor: def lateness(loan: Loan, today: date) -> int:
issues.description: reports.lateness re-implements fines.days_late; the two copies have already drifted apart.

decoys.why_it_is_fine: It iterates over a copy of the keys, so deleting from the dictionary inside the loop is safe.
MD5 is used as a fingerprint to tell exports apart, not for security, and is marked so.
